parent_protocol: Q1484 original exact N131 window-base protocol
recovery_rule: Recompute each raw orbit from ordinal zero using the original frozen projection and representative sources. For all 19,922,944 durable R1-prefix ordinals, compare the recomputed two-bit status to the archived R1 bitmap. At the checkpoint boundary require the recomputed distinct projected-key count to equal R1's progress record. Then process the remaining ordinals into a separate full bitmap and sorted-key digest. Never reuse unverified R1 in-memory state.
scratch_policy: Use a separate r2 run directory on /private/tmp via a temporary worktree symlink; after process completion, replace the symlink with the byte-identical archived directory in this branch. Keep R1 files immutable.
success_gates: Publish exact R1 checkpoint hash, parent source hashes, R2 source and checked Sage runtime before launching R2.
Recompute and compare every archived R1 two-bit status and the R1 unique-key count at the durable boundary.
Process exactly 2^26 raw orbits, archive all statuses, by-span counts, B, K, and sorted projected-set SHA-256.
Independently audit full bitmap counts and direct group-law samples before using the base in a budget screen.
claim_scope: Exact factor-base geometry only. No relation yield, stage success cost, or complete N131 2^x is measured.
